messages:
maria: Heads up — starting a small canary for the new price sheet (v2) tomorrow 09:00 PT. Primary ask: confirm grandfathering logic for accounts on legacy tier with credits applied. Summary below. /cc @arjun @david

arjun: Quick Qs: 1) how many accounts are in 'legacy-credit + dedicated' bucket? 2) are refunds automated or manual?

david: Roughly ~1.2k accounts in that bucket (estimate). Refunds are manual today — we reconcile at invoice time. Recommend we surface quick credit automation for canary if feasible.

maria: Proposal: canary at 5% of traffic, 24h window, manual monitoring. Rollback if invoice delta vs baseline > 3% (by cohort). Anyone opposed?

kevin: Do we have the SQL to compute invoice delta so I can run it during canary?

arjun: SQL snippet you can use:
```
SELECT acct_id, SUM(new_charges)-SUM(old_charges) as delta
FROM billing_runs
WHERE run_date >= '2026-03-01' AND run_date < '2026-03-08'
GROUP BY acct_id
HAVING ABS(delta) > 0
```
Use run_date window appropriate for canary.

sarah: tagging @billing-bot to run cohort export for the ~1.2k accounts so we have the list.

billing-bot: export queued — link: https://redwood.internal/exports/exp-20765 (status: queued)

david: Also opened vendor ticket with Acme Cloud for pass-through discount validation (#AC-442). Waiting vendor confirmation on whether discounts change under new sheet.

maria: Action items before flip: 1) kevin run delta SQL and upload CSV to /shared/finance/canary-v2 2) sarah get cohort export from billing-bot 3) david chase vendor 4) arjun draft rollback comms. I'll approve canary start once CSV sanity-check passes.

kevin: On it. ETA ~2 hours.

arjun: I'll draft an email + status blurb for customers impacted if we need to rollback. Keep it short.

sarah: Export done, 1,182 accounts. Uploading now.

kevin: CSV uploaded: /shared/finance/canary-v2/delta_2076504321.csv — quick topline: mean delta 0.4% across cohort, 12 accounts > 5% delta. Will push to ops and follow up on outliers.

maria: Thanks. @david can you confirm vendor discounts for those 12 outliers? If unexplained, we rollback.

david: Vendor response: 9 of 12 explained by legacy pass-through mapping. 3 require manual credit adjustments; finance will process credits on next invoice cycle. Approving credits now.

maria: Ok, moving canary from 5% -> 20% in 30m, monitoring in 60m windows. Rollback if >3% invoice delta persists. :thumbsup:

kevin: Noted — I'll re-run the delta query every 30m and post updates.

arjun: Rollback message drafted and queued for customer comms (if needed).

sarah: Confirmed upload + cohort mapping attached to the CSV.

maria: Closing loop — thanks all. If anything anomalous appears, ping #incidents and escalate. End.
